limits: Human only: ClinVar publishes one VCF per assembly, GRCh37 and GRCh38.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which ClinVar records does this release VCF hold in this region?

description: Read one region of ClinVar's monthly release VCF, as the VCF ClinVar publishes: its header, then every record overlapping the region, through the release's tabix index so only those blocks are fetched. The ID column is the ClinVar Variation ID and INFO carries ClinVar's own CLNSIG, CLNREVSTAT and CLNDN. Use it to put ClinVar's calls for a locus beside your own.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

chrom.description: the chromosome, with or without its chr prefix.

end.description: last base of the region (1-based, inclusive).

max_records.description: cap on records returned; the result says when the region held more.

name: fetch_clinvar_vcf

endpoints.description: the VCF and index URLs actually read

fileDate.description: the release's own ##fileDate, which names the release read

records.description: how many records the region returned

summary.description: which release was read, and how many records the region held

truncated.description: whether the region held more records than max_records

vcf.description: ClinVar's header and the region's records, as the file holds them
